name: Omakey
author: sonlndv
description: Input languages for Omarchy, built on fcitx5. English and Vietnamese (Telex/VNI) out of the box; add Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Thai and more. Ctrl+Shift cycles through your languages.

barWidget.description: Language badge (EN, VI, JA, KO, ZH, TH) with a menu to switch, add and remove languages and an Omakey Settings dashboard. Ctrl+Shift or right click cycles through your languages.

schema.label: Fallback refresh (ms)
schema.description: The badge updates on its own when you switch with Omakey, Ctrl+Shift or a window change. This slow check only catches switches made with fcitx5's own hotkeys.

schema.label: Show the input mode next to the badge (Telex/VNI, Pinyin/Zhuyin)
